plugins.name: trazum
plugins.description: What your AI agents cost, read from the logs on this machine: one bill across Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI by project, model and period, with no API key and no upload. Also deterministic prompt optimisation, token budgets and drift gates for CI, usage-log profiling that names what would actually move the bill, and MCP tools for native usage imports, spend guards, savings plans and outcome verification.
